segments.text: For that yogi, it is next sutra, he is explained here.
Yadātu sāthma-rāmadhāma eva-i-cheti,
when he desires to reside in his own nature peacefully,
without creating agitation outside and inside, universal agitation.
Because when earthquake takes place, everybody is agitated.
When destruction takes place, everybody is agitated.
And so on.
Then he resides in his own unagitated state of consciousness, god consciousness.
Then what happens to him?
Mahārāna-sandhāna-mantra-virya-nubhā.
Then by attempt to continuity of meditation
on great ocean of consciousness.
Then he meditates on the great ocean of consciousness
with attentive continuity.
It must be continued and with attention.
Mantra-virya-nubhā.
The power of mantras, the power of supreme-i is achieved.
Parābhā-tārika-sambit-i-chāśakt-i-pramukham-
sthūl-mē-i-parintam-visham-vaman-ti.
In fact, this supreme energy of consciousness
creates this universe just right from his internal energy of will,
to his energy of creation, energy of action,
right from energy of will to the energy of action,
create a shakti, and creates the whole universe.
Kēchiri-cakrād-i-yēsh-i-vā-pravārta-kātu-sachat-i-anāvratat-i-gumbh-i-rat-tād-i-darm-i-yoga-at-mahārada.
And that supreme consciousness is said to be just like great ocean
because there are so many flows rising in that universal consciousness,
flows of shāb, sound, flows of touch, smell,
all that, all those flows are rising from that universal consciousness.
And it is that universal consciousness is sachat-tu, sachat-tu,
absolutely pure, transparent, anāvratat-tu,
and nobody can stop its flow.
Gambi-yarat-tu, and the flow, the depth of flow is unlimited.
The depth of flow of this supreme god consciousness is unlimited.
So, it is said to be just like supreme great ocean.
When he puts meditation, when he meditates on that supreme god consciousness,
how antar mukta-yā anāratam tattādāt-i-muhat-shana,
then he diverts all his organs, all his flows of organs to introverted state,
not bear-mukh, not extroverted.
Vakyamāna-sya-sabdhara-sya-svara-atma-kparānta-vyumarsimaya-si-mantravirya-si-anubhava,
the mantra-virya is obtained by that way of meditation,
because that mantra-virya is the power of all letters,
beginning from earth to shell, beginning from A to Z,
because all sounds arise from those letters from A to Z,
and that sound is called shabdhara-si,
and the power and the essence of all those sounds is one sound,
soundless sound, that is i, that is sound of i being,
aham, supreme i, and that is mantra-virya.
Mantravirya is obtained by him, not in an objective way,
that this is mantra-virya, this is mantra-virya,
this is realizing it in objective way.
I am mantra-virya.
This is realizing mantra-virya in subjective way.
In subjective way, he realizes this mantra-virya,
not in objective way. Do you understand?
Yes, the mantra-virya have anything to do with sound,
yes, partly you need to come to the next awakening.
Sathma-rupa-taya-supra-nam-bhaviti, Sathma-rupa-taya-supra-nam-bhaviti means
this takes place in his subjective consciousness,
and not in objective consciousness.
It does not experience that mantra-virya,
that as this is mantra-virya, not in this way.
I am mantra-virya.
This is realizing it in subjective way.
This is the Vimalana.
Both, the Vimalana and the Vimalana also come in this?
This is correct.
Yasa-saktir Jagad-dha-to-kachita-sama-va-in-i,
that supreme energy of Sathandaya, independent energy.
Highest independent energy of Lord Shiva is called,
he has to be one with Lord Shiva.
He has begun from this point in Mahalini-vijitantra.
Then, from Sathandarshakti rises the energy of will,
then energy of knowledge gets its rise,
then energy of action gets its rise,
then universal.
All energies flow out.
So, the flowing center from where the flow out is Sathandarshakti.
Yacharya-pramaka-panchashat-beda-ru-pata-ya,
matrika-malini-ru-patam, asesh-vishamai-mashakti-pradarshya.
So, he has explained that this Sathandarshakti,
this energy of Sathandaya of Lord Shiva,
creates universal energies,
not only will knowledge and action.
All universal energies are created by that,
one energy of Lord Shiva.
Tatyeva-mantro-dharo-darshita.
It is why the rise of mantra,
the rise of supreme-ai is explained in that.
The supreme-ai is everywhere,
held by yogis.
In this also, in i also,
in that also,
in first person, in second person, in third person,
the universal first person takes place.
Not individual first person,
because as long as these persons are concerned,
these are all individual persons.
First person is i, second person is you,
third person is he,
when there is you, universal person,
that is i, that is i in i,
i in you, i in him.
So, it is universal i.
So, supreme energy of Lord Shiva,
that is Sathandarshakti,
is said to be as just like
Maharata, supreme,
ocean of consciousness.
So, Tat Anasandha-Nak,
when you concentrate on that supreme energy of Lord Shiva,
then one gets attainment and achievement
or experiences the state of Mantra-virya,
which is held or experienced
in the world of Madhricajakra
in the world of Madhricajakra,
is the successive creative way,
creative way of i consciousness
and successive destructive way of i consciousness
is Madhricajakra.
Understand, successive destructive way of consciousness.
So, successive creative way of consciousness,
is as good as Aham
and successive destructive way of i consciousness.
i consciousness is as good as Mahah.
It is destructive and it is creative.
And in both ways he experiences the state of i consciousness.
So, it is well said in Spanda
that Tadakrimyubala Mantra,
all Mantras,
live on that one mantra of i consciousness.
All Mantras get life.
They live in that mantra,
in that supreme i.
Thus, in this first awakening of Shiva Sutras,
the first Sutra was Chaitanya Mahatma.
So, he has begun with the Chaitanya Mahatma.
God consciousness is your Self.
Tad saatantri ava-yaset,
tad akchaitanya Mahyam, sarmayubandam,
yathokta, with the Mahatma,
bairav samapati, prasamayanti.
So, first he has accepted that this Self
is in real sense, in fact, consciousness.
Consciousness is Self,
body is not Self, mind is not Self,
organs are not Self.
What is Self? Consciousness.
Consciousness is Self.
And absence of consciousness,
when the state of consciousness is absent
or lessened or becomes weakened,
then you must know that the rise of malas have begun.
Impurities have risen.
And those impurities are three.
And those are also explained in that first awakening
after the first Sutra,
Gyanambandha, Yonivarga Kalasharium,
and so on.
And that bondage is subsided by the bairava
that is the supreme flow of effort,
supreme flow of super-effort,
with the mow bairava.
And then this whole universe becomes divine,
filled with divinity.
Visham saananda amrathamayam karoti.
And Sarvaja Siddhi, Mantri Viri, Anapraveshantadadati.
And all powers, yogic powers,
limited yogic powers, unlimited yogic powers,
or internal residents of your own nature
are bestowed by that being.
With Shambhopayam prathana-atmaam prathmaam mesya-uktha.
So, this first awakening of Shusutras,
which is one with Shambhopaya, is explained.
Though there are at many places,
the hinds of Shaktopaya also.
Atratu ma-de-shakt-suru-pam-uktha.
But that Shambhopaya-sya,
Shaktimatta pratharsina-viprayana,
but that Shaktopaya is described only just to carry you towards Shambhopaya,
just to see that it is to make distinction between Shaktopaya and Shambhopaya.
Yatushivam.
So, there is the end of first awakening.
